set -euo pipefail
PUB='/root/.openclaw/workspace/sim_rsa_public.pem'
AUTH="$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"
touch "$AUTH"
chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh"
chmod 600 "$AUTH"
# convert PEM public key to OpenSSH format
SSH_PUB=$(ssh-keygen -i -m PKCS8 -f "$PUB")
# append if not already present
if ! grep -Fqx "$SSH_PUB" "$AUTH"; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PUB" >> "$AUTH"
fi

echo "Appended (or already present):"
tail -n 1 "$AUTH"
